title: Staff Phone
description: The RAW phone's home. Behind the staff wall. Q4.
x-reads: adminpanel: within the live staff scope
x-why-separate: A Firestore get returns the WHOLE document. Rules do not redact fields. So if the raw phone lived on the drivers doc, the driver's own read of that doc would return it, no matter how the rule is written. The only way to keep the raw phone out of the driver's read path is to put it in a different collection with a different rule.

phone.description: The RAW phone. Never sent to the driver app. Never sent to the user app.
